name: Haven: Mages of Magic
source:
Being accepted into Haven, you will meet fellow classmates, study hard, and unearth the secrets terrorizing the students on campus.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
成功被黑文魔法学院录取后，你将结识同窗好友、刻苦研习魔法，并揭开令校园学子人心惶惶的恐怖秘密。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
